Use varied tones (e.g., enthusiastic, grateful, casual, professional) and mention specific aspects like product features, delivery speed, pricing, or staff friendliness. Incorporate subtle nuances, such as mild praise or constructive suggestions alongside positivity, to mimic real-world feedback. Ensure text length varies from concise one-liners to detailed multi-sentence reviews.
